## Description

**What**: Implement the visual-evaluator skill at plugins/dso/skills/visual-evaluator/SKILL.md that gates screenshot capture on explicit preconditions, captures Playwright screenshots, synthesizes design manifests, and degrades observably when preconditions fail.

**Why**: The agent needs orchestration logic that runs it at the right time, on the right routes, with the right inputs — and fails clearly when environment prerequisites are missing.

**Scope**:
- IN: SKILL.md with EMIT-PRECONDITIONS landmark and 4 named gates
- IN: Screenshot capture at routes from .ui-discovery-cache/route-map.json
- IN: Design manifest synthesis from .claude/design-notes.md + route metadata + Figma (graceful degrade)
- IN: Degradation channel reporting for all 4 failure modes
- IN: Regression tests
- OUT: Sprint integration wiring (draft-4, draft-5a)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, SKILL.md emits EMIT-PRECONDITIONS and gates on exactly these 4 named preconditions: (1) project_type=web, (2) playwright_available (browser binary verified at startup), (3) check-local-env.sh exit 0, (4) route_map_fresh<24h
  <- Satisfies: sc-2
- When this story is complete, precondition failure writes visual_eval_inapplicable:<reason> to ticket AND integration gate status — not silent soft-pass
  <- Satisfies: sc-2
- When this story is complete, route-map.json is sourced from .ui-discovery-cache/route-map.json; if absent emits visual_eval_inapplicable:route_map_missing and documents required setup in skill docs
  <- Satisfies: sc-2
- When this story is complete, Playwright browser absence emits visual_eval_inapplicable:screenshot_runtime_missing
  <- Satisfies: sc-2
- When this story is complete, 24h staleness interaction is documented: sprint integration (draft-4) must surface visual_eval_inapplicable:route_map_stale prominently
  <- Satisfies: sc-2
- When this story is complete, regression tests verify: (a) fixture route produces expected aggregated output; (b) absent route map produces visual_eval_inapplicable annotation (not soft-pass); (c) 500-route fixture excluded from scoring
  <- Satisfies: sc-2
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Dependency] route-map.json produced by dso:ui-discover; skill docs must instruct users to run /dso:ui-discover before invoking
- [Security] Health probe must validate auth_required routing to prevent unauthenticated capture of restricted routes

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue. Escalate only when genuinely blocked. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
